text:
Before: canned peaches (~80 g, ~50 kcal), strawberries (~70 g, ~23 kcal), coffee with milk (~250 ml, ~80 kcal), milk bottle (~300 ml), muesli (~60 g, ~230 kcal) and Brownes peaches & cream yogurt (~150 g, ~150 kcal).

After: both fruit bowls are empty, the coffee is mostly finished and the yogurt is finished. The muesli is mostly eaten, with milk left in the bowl. About 100 ml of milk remains in the bottle, so roughly 200 ml was poured on the cereal. Some of that milk (~60 ml) is left in the bowl, so roughly 150 ml of milk was consumed (~100 kcal).

| Item | Mass eaten (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Muesli (~95% eaten) | 57 | 215 |
| Milk | 150 | 100 |
| Yogurt | 150 | 150 |
| Peaches | 80 | 50 |
| Strawberries | 70 | 23 |
| Coffee (~230 g) | 230 | 75 |
| Sugar sachets (2 opened?) | 6 | 24 |

The sugar sachets appear unopened, so I left them out of the total. Without sugar, the total is about 613 kcal and 737 g.
